headline: Revenue, income, and margins all expand together
summary_short: Revenue rose 11.8% year over year to $4.41 billion, while net income increased 21.1% to $753 million and diluted EPS grew 25.4% to $12.03.
summary_long: Revenue was $4.41 billion, up 11.8% y/y and 10.7% q/q. Gross profit rose to $1.73 billion (+13.0% y/y, +17.9% q/q), with gross margin near 39.3% versus 38.9% a year ago and 36.9% the prior quarter. EBIT was $1.19 billion (+17.3% y/y) and operating income was $1.14 billion (+14.1% y/y); EBITDA reached $2.01 billion (+13.3% y/y). Net income grew 21.1% y/y and 41.8% q/q to $753 million. Diluted EPS rose to $12.03 (+25.4% y/y, +42.7% q/q) and basic EPS to $12.04 (+25.5% y/y).
